messages:
oliver: Quick coordination: proposing we postpone the hard unpin of runtime 3.2 for hosted until we validate SDK streaming behavior. Suggest staged unpin with compatibility flag.
priya: Saw intermittent 1.5% request failure in eu-west on last canary. Need to ensure fallback routing is ready.
marcos: Reproduced a streaming chunk boundary change causing a few clients to hang when chunk sizes align a certain way. Patch ready but prefer flag-based mitigation.
deploybot: scheduling preflight for cohorts [canary-small-eu, canary-us] at 2026-05-10T09:00:00-07:00.
qa-runner: QA can do targeted regression on canary sample set if we give manifests by 07:30 PT. Expect 2.5h.
sdk-lead: We'll ship a client guard flag off by default in JS/py SDKs within the day. Recommend enabling only after cohort reaches 50%.
oncall-bot: note: oncall escalation will trigger if error rate >3% sustained 5m during rollout.
oliver: Proposed plan: 1) Delay full unpin. 2) Rollforward to runtime 3.2 for canaries with compat_mode=stream_guard. 3) Concurrency cap 25%. 4) Auto-stepdown to runtime 2.14 for cohort if errors >2% for 3m. 5) SDK guard shipped off by default. Any blockers?
priya: Ops ok if we keep concurrency cap. Will prepare routing rule and autoscaler tweak.
marcos: I'll land the patch behind compat_mode and prepare rollback steps.
deploybot: preflight result: canary-small-eu PASS, canary-us WARNING (p99 +0.9%). Holding expansion.
qa-runner: QA requests we hold until we finish longseq stress run.
oliver: Hold acknowledged. We'll not widen until QA signs off. I'll update #eng-releases after QA clears. :thumbsup:
